submitted.rationale: All 5 EQE measurements across the line (Sb 0.14–0.80) are ~0 (|EQE| < 0.002%), consistent with wide-gap Mg–Sb–O phases (MgO, MgSb2O6 trirutile) not absorbing 2.1 eV photons. Index 22 (Sb≈0.67, near MgSb2O6 stoichiometry) gave the highest measured value (0.00142%), though differences are within noise.
